pairs.difference: B: the bat's round body is one soft, airbrushed top-to-bottom gradient. A thin glossy rim runs along the wing arms and ear edges, and there is no real shadow side or core shadow, so form contrast of 0.323 sits just under the real floor. It reads as vinyl. A: the envelope is lit gently from the front, with soft shading on the flap creases and a slight turn along the lower edge, which fits the milder real cards.
pairs.fix: Light the bat from the upper left. Make the lower right of the body and the far wing clearly darker with a cool shadow side, and remove the thin shiny line tracing the wing edges.

pairs.difference: A: the cauldron's body is one slow dark gradient with almost no highlight or defined light side, light bias of 0.815 is above the real range, and a dense flat oval shadow sits under it. Its lens shading is neutral violet. B: the sneakers are even and frontal (bias 0.019, below range) with a long crisp cast shadow to the left, but their shoe sides and shadow turn cool blue-grey in the lens as the real cards do. Both are off, so this is a weak call.
pairs.fix: Give the cauldron a broad soft sheen on the upper left of the belly, a cooler reflected glow low on the right side, and a softer shadow on the stone that fades out from the feet.

pairs.difference: B: the pumpkins are bathed in warm ambient light. The lens stays tan all over, the rib shading is gentle and even, and the sides barely fall away (form contrast 0.397, near the floor). There is no cool shadow side or defined cast shadow on the grass. A: the topiary has lit tops and dark blue undersides on each tier, plus a clear blue cast shadow to the right on the ground, which matches the real cool form shadows.
pairs.fix: Light the pumpkins from one upper side, turn their far sides and undersides into cool, darker shadow, and add a soft blue-toned shadow on the grass under the group.

pairs.difference: B: the suitcase matches the real suitcase on the reference sheet, with soft frontal light, a gentle turn at the corners and a faint floor shadow. A: the column has a clean plum shadow side on the left volute and shaft, a smooth turn across the flutes and a lit top slab. Its numbers are in range, so there is no shading reason to call it generated.

A: the tombstone's front face is nearly flat with light shading (form contrast 0.378, below range), yet a small glassy sheen sits on the upper-left moss and stone shoulder like a plastic spot on rock, and the cast shadow is a crisp dark shape on the grass. B: the slide has a stronger turn around the tube, cool blue shadow insides and soft shadows cast by the supports.
pairs.fix: Remove the shiny spot from the stone. Shade the face so it darkens gradually toward the right edge, and soften the edge of the grass shadow as it moves away from the base.

pairs.difference: B: the broom head is lit almost evenly, with only strand-by-strand dark lines and no overall round shadow side. A long hard-edged shadow streaks across the floor, and the handle turns only slightly. Light bias of 1.386 is far above range. A: the mower has a broad soft sheen on the red hood and cool blue form shadows on the tyres and underside, as the real cards do.
pairs.fix: Treat the broom head as one rounded mass: lit on the upper side, cool and darker on the lower side. Make the floor shadow shorter and softer, and darken it only where the bristles touch the floor.

pairs.difference: A: the house's bright windows throw no glow onto their frames or nearby stone, the walls are uniformly dark (form contrast 0.623, above range) under a bright sky, and thin edge highlights outline the roof trim rather than showing where light falls. B: the door has one clear light direction, with dappled ivy shadows cast across the door and frame and soft bevel highlights on the panels.
pairs.fix: Choose one side for the daylight, brighten the walls facing it, and let the window glow spill softly onto the surrounding frames and stones.

pairs.difference: A: the pumpkin's ribs turn in a very smooth airbrushed way from a pale left edge to a dark lower right, the shading range of 0.855 is above real cards, and the face glow is flat and bright with little spill onto the cut walls. B: the jacket's shading is simple but follows folds, pockets and cuff openings, and its numbers stay in range.
pairs.fix: Keep the shadow side less extreme, and let the inner glow light the cut edges of the eyes and mouth with a warm falloff into the orange skin.

pairs.difference: A: the crystal ball has almost no shading across the sphere, with no shadow side, lower refraction or bounce from the table. The lens is milky and flat (form contrast 0.335, bias 0.158, both below range), and only a small sharp window highlight sits at the upper right. A hard dark shadow lies under the stand. B: the vending machine has a clear dark side plane, a lit front face with a soft turn, and a soft floor shadow, all in range.
pairs.fix: Show the sphere as round glass: a darker rim all around, a bright curved glow inside the lower edge opposite the highlight, warm table colour reflected at the bottom, and a soft shadow with a light pool in it.

pairs.difference: A: the coffin is split abruptly between an evenly bright lid and evenly dark sides, the lid shows almost no gradient, and light bias of 0.917 is above range. The lens stays warm, so no cool shadow side appears. B: the rocking chair has rounded turn on the arms, cushion and seat, with a soft cast shadow and floor reflection, and it is in range.
pairs.fix: Add a gentle gradient across the lid, lift the dark sides with a cool soft reflected light from the floor, and add a soft sheen along the rounded lid edge.

pairs.difference: B: the street lamp's glass reads as a dull flat fill with a blurry bulb blob and no glow on the metal, and form contrast of 0.68 is above range because the dark post falls heavily into shadow. A: the candelabra's gold shows soft broad bands of sheen and a clear turn around the stem, dark under the base and in range. This is a weak call.
pairs.fix: Make the bulb glow with soft falloff through the glass, let warm light touch the inside of the dome and the frame, and lift the shadow side of the post with a soft teal reflected light.

pairs.difference: A: the balloons have a smooth round turn, one soft highlight at the same upper-left spot on each and cool shadow on their lower edges, all in range and close to the real bottle and lens shading. B: the ship has lit sails, a darker cool right side on the hull and a soft sea reflection, also in range. Neither shows a clear shading fault.

pattern: Generated cards still give themselves away through weak or unmotivated light on the hero. Light sits evenly on the form or splits abruptly, with no cool, clearly placed shadow side. Generated cards often stay warm in the shading lens, where real cards fall into cool blue form shadow with a gradual turn. Other signs are thin glossy edge lines, small plastic highlights on matte materials, emissive parts (windows, glows) that do not light their surroundings, and hard flat cast shadows instead of soft contact darkening.
